premise: Hermit Crab's shell feels tight, so he goes house hunting: the bucket is too big, the sand castle too crumbly, and his own shell turns out just right for now.
inspiration: Goldilocks' three tries (folk tale), turned around: the right house was the one he had, and the bigger one can wait until he has grown.
lesson: What you have can be just right for now.
learning: A hermit crab lives in an empty shell it finds, and moves to a bigger one as it grows.

en-US.title: A Bigger House
en-US.text: {bucket:enter} {castle:enter} {hermit-crab:enter} {hermit-crab:go to sand} Hermit Crab came scuttling over the sand, {hermit-crab:face sad} and he sighed. His striped shell felt a little bit tight. It was a borrowed shell, like every hermit crab's: an empty one he had found and moved into. And now he was growing. {hermit-crab:face happy} Time for a bigger one! [curious] {hermit-crab:live look-around} So Hermit Crab went house hunting. First, the red bucket. {hermit-crab:go to bucket} He peeked inside. {bucket:wobble} It was enormous! [playfully] Hello… hello… hello… went the echo. {hermit-crab:face surprised} Far too big. Next, the sand castle, with its little red flag. {hermit-crab:go to castle} He tried the door. {castle:live wobble} {sfx:crumble} Crumble, crumble. {hermit-crab:face sad} Far too sandy. [short pause] Then a little wave came rushing up, {bucket:live wash} {sfx:splash} splash, all around the bucket! {hermit-crab:face surprised} Hermit Crab was so surprised {hermit-crab:live hide hold} that he tucked himself right inside his own shell. [softly] And inside… it was cosy. Just the right size, for today. {hermit-crab:live hide resume} He peeked out, {hermit-crab:face happy} and smiled. A bigger house could wait.

es-ES.title: Una casa más grande
es-ES.text: {bucket:enter} {castle:enter} {hermit-crab:enter} {hermit-crab:go to sand} Cangrejo Ermitaño llegó correteando por la arena, {hermit-crab:face sad} y suspiró. Su concha de rayas le quedaba un poquito justa. Era una concha prestada, como las de todos los ermitaños: una vacía que había encontrado para vivir dentro. Y ahora estaba creciendo. {hermit-crab:face happy} ¡Tocaba buscar una más grande! [curious] {hermit-crab:live look-around} Así que Ermitaño salió a buscar casa. Primero, el cubo rojo. {hermit-crab:go to bucket} Se asomó dentro. {bucket:wobble} ¡Era enorme! [playfully] Hola… hola… hola…, contestaba el eco. {hermit-crab:face surprised} Demasiado grande. Después, el castillo de arena, con su banderita roja. {hermit-crab:go to castle} Probó la puerta. {castle:live wobble} {sfx:crumble} Cruc, cruc, se desmoronaba. {hermit-crab:face sad} Demasiado arenoso. [short pause] Entonces llegó corriendo una olita {bucket:live wash} {sfx:splash} y, ¡chof!, salpicó todo el cubo. {hermit-crab:face surprised} Ermitaño se sorprendió tanto {hermit-crab:live hide hold} que se metió del todo en su propia concha. [softly] Y dentro… se estaba de maravilla. Justo de su tamaño, por hoy. {hermit-crab:live hide resume} Se asomó, {hermit-crab:face happy} y sonrió. La casa grande podía esperar.

ja-JP.title: ヤドカリくんの おうちさがし
ja-JP.text: {bucket:enter}{castle:enter}{hermit-crab:enter}{hermit-crab:go to sand}ヤドカリくんが、砂の上をちょこちょこやってきて、{hermit-crab:face sad}ふうっと、ためいき。しましまのかいがらが、ちょっぴりきゅうくつなのです。ヤドカリはみんな、からっぽのかいがらを見つけて、おうちにします。そしてヤドカリくんは、いま、ぐんぐん大きくなっているところ。{hermit-crab:face happy}もっと大きなおうちに、おひっこしだ！[curious]{hermit-crab:live look-around}ヤドカリくんは、おうちさがしに出かけました。まずは、赤いバケツ。{hermit-crab:go to bucket}なかを、のぞいてみると…{bucket:wobble}ひろーい！[playfully]「こんにちはー…ちはー…はー…」 と、こだまがかえってきます。{hermit-crab:face surprised}これじゃ、大きすぎ。つぎは、赤いはたの立った、砂のお城。{hermit-crab:go to castle}入り口に、もぐってみると…{castle:live wobble}{sfx:crumble}さらさら、ぽろぽろ。{hermit-crab:face sad}これじゃ、くずれちゃう。[short pause]そのとき、小さな波が、ざざーっとかけあがってきて、{bucket:live wash}{sfx:splash}ざぶん！バケツのまわりは、水びたしです。{hermit-crab:face surprised}ヤドカリくんは、びっくりして、{hermit-crab:live hide hold}じぶんのかいがらに、すっぽり。[softly]なかは…ぬくぬく。きょうのぼくに、ちょうどいい大きさです。{hermit-crab:live hide resume}ひょっこり顔を出して、{hermit-crab:face happy}にっこり。大きなおうちは、もっと大きくなってからね。
